sections.title: New
notes: Link other song folders, like your osu! Songs folder, so you can play those charts without copying them.
Skins can now change almost everything about how the game looks.
Skins can animate any image and can use different settings and images for each key count.
Export, delete and import skins.
When a skin has a mistake in it, Nascent tells you what's wrong as soon as you pick it.
Note opacity and Receptor opacity settings in Options.
Change the volume anywhere with Alt and the mouse wheel, or Alt and Up or Down.
Press F7 on the results screen to open your replay on the website.
An Instant restart option in Options under Keys, so the restart key restarts straight away instead of needing to be held.
Press Shift and F2 to go back to the song you had before shuffling.
Sort the song list by key count.
Press Ctrl and F5 on the song list to reload every chart and recalculate every difficulty.
A Credits screen and changelog, both in Options under About.
Replays have a seek bar at the bottom.

sections.title: Improved
notes: Big song folders load much faster. After the first launch the song list opens almost straight away, and new or changed songs are picked up in the background.
The loading bar on the title screen now covers every step of loading your songs, so it no longer sits full while the game is still working.
Picking a song on a slow drive no longer freezes the game. The song loads in the background and its preview starts as soon as it's ready.
Scrollbars on the song list and in Options can be clicked and dragged.
The results screen's hit error graph is labelled Early and Late.
Clearing a search keeps the song you had selected, even when the search had no results.
The account screen opens on Create account the first time, and both forms have a button to submit them.
Creating an account asks you to type your password twice.
Sign up errors explain exactly what's wrong with the username or password.
A newly imported skin shows up in the Options skin list right away.

sections.title: Fixed
notes: Songs you deleted can be downloaded again.
Notes and other images drawn small no longer have a sliver of their right or bottom edge cut off.

sections.title: Online
notes: The website's download button has a menu with the downloads for every platform.
Very old versions of the game are now told to update before their plays can be submitted.
